verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs say founders can grant accountants access to their account under admin, editor, or viewer roles (Pro), plus free payroll-manager and Block Advisors tax-pro roles. That covers inviting a bookkeeper with role-scoped access. However, the review-versus-adjust permissions for each role are not documented, and the scoped roles are gated to the paid Pro plan. missing for 10: per-role permission details showing an editor can adjust ledger entries, documentation of the invite flow, a free-tier general bookkeeper role, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Grant trusted individuals—like partners, collaborators, or accountants—access to your Wave account as a payroll manager or Block Advisors tax pro (free), or admin, editor, or viewer (Pro).
Add multiple users, such as your bookkeeper or accountant
